capabilities: Open a dedicated Stardew Pets Farm sidebar view
Add named pets from a plus menu
Click pets to trigger reactions and heart bubbles
Remove pets and decorations via remove mode
extras: Sprites are bundled into main.js so store installs need no separate sprites folder; pet and decoration placements persist in plugin data.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add ambient, interactive pixel pets or decorations for a fun workspace touch.

relations.evidence: Inspired by BOTPanzer. Thank you so much!!!

summary: Playful sidebar view where Stardew Valley-style pixel pets wander, sleep, react to clicks, and live among placeable pixel decorations.
